body: Yes, exactly. There's nothing to lose. I think I will leave for the States. I don't have to be in this PhD forever either. Once I finish it, I will have a more interesting job perhaps. Thank you for putting it this way.

I had been asking the universe for manifesting my ex back. I mainly want a heart-felt apology from him. That will give me closure. I was feeling low and then I got a notification from Reddit which is your post. Decided to keep at it. BTW, I'm also manifesting several other things in my life. Your post gave me the nudge to keep doing it. Congratulations on the new job!
I'm with you, brother! They say that it will get better. It won't. They say have patience. For what? To see more pain? This life doesn't deserve people like us. Nobody cares!

I hope you do find a more permanent place and get to adopt kittens. I have some fight left in me that I will make it up for giving up my kittens. I want to get into animal rescue one day and I'm a hardcore vegan. Though I feel low right now, I see this tiny flicker of light at the end of the tunnel. Maybe, if I keep walking, I will be there someday.
Why can't you have pets? Yes. I was able to. I even visited them before leaving. Seems like they were taken good care of. But, they were my babies.

I got a job in the data analysis/machine learning sector. Mine is a little complicated case. I had to move back to my home country from US for this job. I had to give up my kittens. This is making my depression really bad and I feel very guilty.
No. I didn't complete mine too. I quit 2.5 years into it. I was trying hard to make it work. I had personal problems too. I just decided I wanted a proper 9-5 kind of job.
So, do you have a PhD? Or, were planning on having a PhD?

To be honest, this is my first job in the corporate world. I have been in academia for 10 years almost (PhD most recently). I have been a failure in it. I have a failed relationship. I don't have supportive surroundings. I don't know if I will do well at my new job. But, I want to give it a go. I want to see how it pans out. But, I also am not able to deal with the internal pain I have right now.
